features.name: Document Import
features.description: Users can import .txt and .md files via ImportPanel with file picker
features.evidence: Launched the built app in Electron 33 under xvfb via a Playwright `_electron` driver (`xvfb-run -a node exercise.mjs`) and exercised the real app: clicked the '+ Import' button, which rendered ImportPanel with a 'Choose File' button; called window.knowledgeBase.documents.import('/work/data/sample-documents/meeting-summary.txt') over the real IPC bridge and got back a created Document ({id, title:'meeting-summary', filename:'meeting-summary.txt', size:1160, status:'imported'}); after reloading the renderer, DocumentList showed 'Documents (1)' with the new entry. Also verified the file-type validation and error-surfacing path: importing '/tmp/bad-file.pdf' through the same IPC call threw "Unsupported file type \".pdf\". Only .txt and .md files can be imported.", which App.tsx's handleImport catch wires into ImportPanel's error banner via the `error` prop.

features.name: Document Detail with Content
features.description: DocumentDetail shows full document content, metadata, and delete button
features.evidence: In the same live-app run, clicked the imported 'meeting-summary' row in the sidebar and screenshotted the result (/tmp/shots/03-document-detail.png): DocumentDetail rendered title, Filename/Imported/Size/Status metadata, Show Chunks / Index Document / Delete buttons, and the full document text body ('Team Meeting Summary - March 2026 ... Next Steps ...') loaded via window.knowledgeBase.documents.getContent(id) in the component's useEffect.

features.name: Basic Persistence
features.description: Imported documents persist across app restarts via filesystem storage
features.evidence: After importing and indexing the sample document, called app.close() on the Electron instance then relaunched a fresh Electron process pointed at the same userData dir (electron.launch again with the same HOME env). Screenshot /tmp/shots/04-relaunch.png and window.knowledgeBase.documents.list() both show the document reappearing without re-importing: 'Documents (1)' with a ✓ next to 'meeting-summary', and the list entry reporting status:'indexed', chunks:3 -- confirming both filesystem persistence (App.tsx's new mount-time refreshDocuments() effect) and the indexed-status propagation fix in ipc-handlers.ts survive a restart.
